auditor.mode: fresh temporary output; no product source was modified

interpretation.rule: A worktree, a local test, a candidate artifact, or a public HTTP shell is not completion evidence. A product needs its Fable5-specific flow, source/runtime binding, installation and cold-start evidence where applicable, recovery and concurrency coverage, localization evidence, and required Computer Control verification before it can become proven complete.
doNotInfer: public deployment from a candidate build
installed-client success from a web result
full Fable5 completion from a clean worktree
production signing or store release without exact artifact evidence

currentPriority.reason: Standard Wallet Connectivity and installed-client networking are required before horizontal product expansion.
nextEvidence: complete four-node recoverable backup and verify archives
restore Faucet release-manifest identity through the guarded deployment path
resume only leased product migrations under accepted Wallet and endpoint contracts
add product-specific runtime, installed-client and Computer Control evidence incrementally
